notes: Summary: enterprise customer focused on ticket deflection via RAG + reranking. Tight latency SLOs; high indexing scale (100M+ embeddings).
From AE call (Ava) 2026-03-03: wants top-5 rerank precision to match current Solr baseline; 'we need human-like relevance for top answers or we won't see deflection'.

Key metrics requested: 95th pct end-to-end latency < 250ms for user query -> top-5 reranked answers; target throughput 200 qps sustained during business hours; ingest/update window ~nightly with incremental updates throughout day.

Index size: ~120M content chunks currently (docs split by paragraph), expected growth 20% q/q. Average embedding vector dims 1536. Current in-house approximate k-NN costs are high; looking for cost/latency tradeoffs.
Preferred models: embeddings dense options (1536), open models acceptable if latency budget met. Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for quantization & batching.
Security: must run in customer VPC, SOC2 compliance required, KMS-managed keys, audit logging retained 1 year. Data residency: US only (legal team).
POC ask: 2-week focused test demonstrating 1) indexing pipeline for 100M+ vectors, 2) end-to-end query p95 latency numbers with rerank, 3) cost per query estimate at 200 qps.
Quote from Head of Support (call): 'If deflection drops contact volume 20% without harming CSAT, this is deployable.'
Slack/ops note: trial dataset sanitized and uploaded to s3://triton-poc/sanitized-2026-02-20 (link in drive).
Risk: current in-house reranker is tuned for top-5; Triton will require demonstration that Redwood's rerank + sparse/dense hybrid can match precision at similar latency.
